notes: The italic is thine closing the כֹל clause is marked added rather than read as a distributed second realization of the written לְךָ under rule 25; the Hebrew clause has no predicate of its own and the second לְךָ opens a clause of its own.
Both occurrences of לְךָ fuse with their suffix into thine under rule 49's genitive clause, the construction's copula joining the fused unit.
